title: MVN Group at vibe 2026 – Architecture Space
description: MVN Group participated in VIBE 2026 – Architecture Space, showcasing two selected projects, Gao Lut House and Vertical Hue – Lang Hue tren cao, alongside leading architecture practices from across Vietnam.
author: MVN Group
content:
From September 30 to October 3, 2026, MVN Group participated in VIBE 2026 – Architecture Space, under the theme “NEXT IN SPACE – GROWTH IN MOTION”.

 

 

 

 

Notably, two projects by MVN Group / NOAM Architecture were selected and invited by the Organizing Committee for exhibition, alongside works from 32 professional architecture firms across Vietnam. The event provided an opportunity for design practices to meet, exchange professional perspectives, and introduce new approaches to space, architecture, and the development of contemporary cities.

The two projects presented at the exhibition were Gao Lut House and Vertical Hue – Lang Hue tren cao. One project explores residential architecture through the lens of climate and local materials; the other explores how community structures, memory, and local ways of life can be integrated into a high-rise housing model.

 

 

 

 

Being selected for exhibition at VIBE 2026 is an opportunity for MVN Group to further connect with the domestic architecture community, while introducing a design approach that places people, context, and local values at the foundation of contemporary living spaces.
